steps.title: is_palindrome ignores case and punctuation
steps.description:
Create is_palindrome(text) in texttools/palin.py.
1. cleaned = ""
2. For each ch in text.lower(): if ch.isalnum(): cleaned = cleaned + ch
3. return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

steps.title: caesar_shift moves letters along the alphabet
steps.description:
Create caesar_shift(text, shift) in texttools/caesar.py. Letters wrap around the alphabet; everything else stays as it is.
1. result = ""
2. For each ch in text:
   - if ch.islower(): result = result + chr((ord(ch) - ord("a") + shift) % 26 + ord("a"))
   - elif ch.isupper(): result = result + chr((ord(ch) - ord("A") + shift) % 26 + ord("A"))
   - else: result = result + ch
3. return result

steps.title: most_common_word finds the word used most
steps.description:
Create most_common_word(text) in texttools/common.py. Words are lowercase and split on spaces. If two words are used equally often, the one that appears first wins.
1. If text.split() is empty, raise ValueError.
2. counts = {} and order = []
3. For each word in text.lower().split():
   - if word not in counts: counts[word] = 0 and order.append(word)
   - counts[word] = counts[word] + 1
4. best = order[0]
5. For each word in order: if counts[word] > counts[best]: best = word
6. return best

steps.title: truncate shortens long text with three dots
steps.description:
Create truncate(text, limit) in texttools/trunc.py.
1. If limit is less than 3, raise ValueError.
2. If len(text) <= limit, return text.
3. return text[:limit - 3] + "..."
